diffs.diff: pin count: part has 11 (GND PWM2 DIR2 PWM1 DIR1 M1B M1A POWER+ POWER- M2A M2B), datasheet reading has 5 (GND PWM2 DIR2 PWM1 DIR1)
diffs.evidence: The second reading counted only the 5-pin logic input header; the MDD10A User's Manual also documents a 6-way screw terminal block, 'Terminal Block – Connect to motor and power source', with positions 1-6 'Motor 1 Output B', 'Motor 1 Output A', 'Positive Supply (positive terminal of battery)', 'Negative Supply (negative terminal of battery)', 'Motor 2 Output A', 'Motor 2 Output B', matching the model's M1B M1A POWER+ POWER- M2A M2B, so 5 + 6 = 11 connections is correct.
